analogy.rationale: Renal function diagnostic agents (e.g., iodinated contrast media, inulin, or para-aminohippurate) are not receptor ligands and do not perturb the transcriptome; they are inert markers cleared by the kidney, so little to no transcriptional response is expected. The closest reference classes are other renally acting or imaging agents that also lack a specific transcriptional program in these cell lines.
